SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

2. Which statement about Mining in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Mining in Kenya.
   B. Treat Mining in Kenya as rumours only.
   C. Explain Mining in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Mining in Kenya never happens in Kenya.

3. Which statement about Weather and Climate is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Weather and Climate as rumours only.
   B. Say Weather and Climate never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Weather and Climate with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Weather and Climate.

4. Which statement about African Traditional Education is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing African Traditional Education.
   B. Treat African Traditional Education as rumours only.
   C. Explain African Traditional Education with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say African Traditional Education never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage as rumours only.
   B. Say Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Main physical features in Kenya ● Relief ● Drainage.

6. Which statement about Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites as rumours only.
   C. Say Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Language Groups in Kenya ● Nilotes ● Bantu ● Cushites.

7. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Avoid saving forever

8. Which statement about Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi.
   C. Say Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Fishing in Kenya Victoria Turkana Naivasha Tana and River Athi with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Avoiding all community work

10. Which statement about The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui.
   C. Say The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain The Built Environments ● Museums ● Monuments ● Cultural centres ● Historical bui with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Mombasa
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nakuru

12. Which statement about Population distribution in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Population distribution in Kenya.
   B. Say Population distribution in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Population distribution in Kenya as rumours only.
   D. Explain Population distribution in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Development of Transport and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Development of Communication Traditional forms: smoke signals Modern forms phone and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Early forms of Governm ent in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Citizenship in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

3. C — Explain Weather and Climate with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. C — Explain African Traditional Education with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. C — Obeying laws and caring for public property

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Development of Transport; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Early forms of Governm ent in Kenya; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Citizenship in Kenya; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
